title: Analysis package for Reproducing and Extending ESP32 Workload Benchmarks on ESP32-C6: Performance and Generated-Code Results
description: Analysis-only companion to an author-owned technical report, not an externally peer-reviewed publication. Contains 21,600 accepted ESP32-C6 timing records projected from validated datasets, local statistics and ratios, separately identified cited historical aggregates and imported numeric static metrics, original Python/MATLAB analysis, manuscript sources, and the report/supplement PDFs. Reproduces timing summaries, four publication figures, and generated result tables. Does not repeat numerical correctness validation, rebuild firmware, rerun hardware, or independently regenerate machine-code evidence. Upstream input/reference arrays, benchmark implementations, native artifacts, disassembly, full console captures, upstream full texts/source recordings, and private Git history are excluded. The complete evidence archive is retained privately pending redistribution review.
